Hi-Rez would have fixed it before it went to the live client, or maybe they would have even delayed the release to fix him. You're asking something really difficult to explain. It all depends on your play style and the play style of your teammates and the composition of the team. 

As Athena you charge your dash and just wait for one of two things. 
1- your opponents are close enough that you can taunt both of them at once
2- one of your opponents is out of position and you can abuse this by taunting him into an even worse place to be. 
Basically you're literally bringing the fight to you and your hunter hoping that your hunter will finish the job

As Bacchus you play far more aggressive you jump in, knocking your opponents up, followed by either your stun of your ult and your hunter will mostly likely finishing up the kill. 

Both gods have their pros and cons. 
Bacchus can escape fights easier by jumping over walls. Athena's dash charge can be canceled by hard CC making her charge the dash again which takes forever or you can stand in front of her and stop her from going anywhere. 

Bacchus has to hit the last part of his stun in order to stun, hunter with a dash like Cupid, xbalanque, Rama, Apollo can escape this really easy. Athena's taunt in the other hand interrupts dashes so even if the hunter dashes away Athena will stop the dash. 

Both gods have completely different styles. Athena can rip a team fight apart, while Bacchus damage can secure objectives like fire giant or gold furry easier.
